dedupe_keys.name: ggcmi phase 3 crop calendar planting and maturity dates

description: The GGCMI Phase 3 crop calendar is a composite of several observational data sources. It gives, for each 0.5 degree land grid cell, the planting day and maturity day of 18 crops, separately for rainfed and irrigated systems. It was made for the Global Gridded Crop Model Intercomparison and is the crop calendar input of the ISIMIP3a and ISIMIP3b agriculture simulations, listed by ISIMIP as a direct human forcing. Cells outside current cropland are extrapolated and data gaps are filled. It gives one growing season per crop and cell and no rotations, except wheat (separate winter and spring calendars) and rice (two main seasons). The Zenodo release is static multi-year averages; ISIMIP also lists annually varying calendars for climate-adapted growing periods under SSP scenarios (2015soc, histsoc, ssp126soc-adapt, ssp370soc-adapt, ssp585soc-adapt). Coverage is global. Access is free on Zenodo (2 July 2021) as one NetCDF4 file per crop and system, version 1.01, under CC BY 4.0. Method details are in Jägermeyr et al. 2021 in Nature Food. Caveats: extrapolated cells are not observations, and the Zenodo version has no year-to-year variation. For simulation it sets the growing-season windows for crop models and for timing hazard exposure, such as heat or drought during flowering. Related catalogue records include the GGCMI outputs, MapSPAM and LPJmL.
